algorithms.name: BFS on an adjacency list (n vertices, m edges)
algorithms.explanation: Each vertex is queued once and each edge is looked at once from each end.

es.explanation: Cada vértice entra una vez a la cola y cada arista se mira una vez desde cada extremo.

algorithms.name: Dijkstra with a binary heap
algorithms.explanation: Each edge can push one heap entry, and each heap operation costs O(log n).

es.explanation: Cada arista puede agregar una entrada al heap, y cada operación del heap cuesta O(log n).

algorithms.name: Bellman–Ford
algorithms.explanation: n − 1 rounds, each relaxing every edge.

es.explanation: n − 1 rondas, y en cada una se relajan todas las aristas.

algorithms.name: Floyd–Warshall
algorithms.explanation: Three nested loops over the vertices: k, then i, then j.

es.explanation: Tres loops anidados sobre los vértices: k, después i, después j.

algorithms.name: Kruskal's minimum spanning tree with a DSU
algorithms.explanation: Sorting the edges dominates; the DSU operations after that are almost O(1) each.

es.explanation: Lo que domina es ordenar las aristas; después, las operaciones del DSU son casi O(1) cada una.

algorithms.name: Topological sort with Kahn's algorithm
algorithms.explanation: Every vertex enters the queue once, and every edge lowers one in-degree once.

es.explanation: Cada vértice entra una vez a la cola, y cada arista baja un grado de entrada una vez.

algorithms.name: Strongly connected components (Tarjan or Kosaraju)
algorithms.explanation: One or two DFS passes over the whole graph.

es.explanation: Una o dos pasadas de DFS sobre todo el grafo.

algorithms.name: Dinic's maximum flow
algorithms.explanation: At most n phases, each finding a blocking flow in O(n·m). (O(n·m²) is Edmonds–Karp's bound.)

es.explanation: A lo sumo n fases, y cada una encuentra un flujo bloqueante en O(n·m). (O(n·m²) es la cota de Edmonds–Karp.)

algorithms.name: LCA with binary lifting: preprocessing plus q queries
algorithms.explanation: The table stores log n ancestors per vertex, and each query makes O(log n) jumps.

es.explanation: La tabla guarda log n ancestros por vértice, y cada consulta hace O(log n) saltos.

algorithms.name: Checking whether a graph is bipartite (2-colouring by BFS or DFS)
algorithms.explanation: One traversal colours every vertex; an edge between two equal colours means an odd cycle.

es.explanation: Un recorrido colorea todos los vértices; una arista entre dos colores iguales significa un ciclo impar.
